Professional Summary
Frontend-focused engineer with strong experience delivering user-facing applications using component-based frameworks and modern styling systems. Skilled at collaborating with product and QA teams to ship performant, accessible interfaces and mobile features. Immediate joiner.

Technical Skills
Vue.js, Javascript, Nuxt.js, CSS, Tailwind CSS, React Native, TypeScript, Linux, Jira

Work Experience
Senior Vue.js Developer, Cognizant (May 2025 - Present)
- Implemented server-side rendered pages and dynamic routes using Nuxt.js, improving page load time by optimizing bundle splitting and async data fetching; used Javascript and CSS to ensure consistent responsive layouts.
- Built reusable component library with Nuxt.js and Vue.js patterns, reducing new feature development time by enabling cross-project reuse; enforced styling conventions and accessibility guidelines in CSS.
- Collaborated with backend and QA teams via Jira to triage issues and deliver weekly releases; refactored legacy Javascript modules to modern Nuxt.js plugin patterns to reduce runtime errors.

Frontend Developer, Ledgerly (Dec 2019 - Apr 2025)
- Developed dashboard and reporting interfaces in Vue.js with Tailwind CSS, delivering pixel-consistent designs and improving front-end rendering performance through code-splitting.
- Led the migration of core UI to a component-driven architecture in Vue.js, creating Tailwind CSS utility-based themes that shortened design-to-production cycles.
- Worked closely with product owners using Jira to prioritize bug fixes and UX improvements; wrote Javascript unit tests and performance benchmarks for critical UI flows.

Mobile Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services (Nov 2017 - Nov 2019)
- Built cross-platform mobile features using React Native and TypeScript, delivering offline-capable screens and synchronized data flows for enterprise clients.
- Implemented TypeScript type-safe modules and optimized bundle sizes on React Native projects, improving app startup time and runtime stability.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies and tracked tasks in Jira; used Linux-based tooling for CI builds and automated test runs.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
